summary: Scoped finite-claim review complete; 4.0/5 across five output-quality axes.

accuracy.evidence: 86 direct public-CLI gate invocations and 86 independent native mirrors have raw rc/stdout/reason receipts; v2 has an exact 26031-byte executable-tail comparison. Hidden gate wait vectors were not instrumented; report explicitly distinguishes native mirrors.
accuracy.improvement: Keep that distinction visible when summarizing receipts; do not label mirror statuses as the exact public invocation's waits.

completeness.evidence: All requested operand/separator/options/stdin/large-small/earlier-later boundaries covered, plus middle-stage and unchanged status controls. LSP semantic checks unavailable because no device is mounted; literal fallback is disclosed.
completeness.improvement: On a host with an answering LSP server, add references/definition/diagnostics receipts rather than treating text search as semantic proof.

clarity.evidence: Findings by severity precede residual risks; v1 tested identity and v2 doc-only identity are separate. Detailed report remains long because it retains exact hashes and scope qualifications.
clarity.improvement: Use terminal structured summary for the short decision and keep full boundary evidence in the report.

actionability.evidence: Low documentation finding was reported to author and fixed before return; complete own probe driver/snapshots/commands are durable. Main must still exercise the assigned canonical committed-input counter, not substitute this independent matrix.
actionability.improvement: Preserve the report's predata-only label in the integration decision.

conciseness.evidence: 43 per-case receipts are indexed by a compact matrix, although each machine-readable receipt repeats fixture identity intentionally for standalone reproducibility.
conciseness.improvement: Link the matrix rather than pasting every JSON into the parent handoff.

top_improvements: Keep v1 test results distinct from the doc-only v2 identity transfer.
Do not confuse corroborating matrix with the one canonical committed-input claim counter.
self_check: The requested finite boundaries and independently observed BASE/candidate outcomes are complete; this review does not grant admission authority.
